# Sponsor tiers

## Monthly tier — Supporter (US$5 / month)
Tier price: $5 / month

Tier description:
Support the Refill Labels project with a small monthly contribution. Sponsors will have their profile badge displayed on the sponsors page and receive monthly email updates with development progress, design previews, and early access to new label templates.

Welcome message (shown after payment / in welcome email):
Thank you for becoming a Supporter! Your monthly contribution helps cover CI, hosting and design iteration. Expect a welcome email with a short survey so rewards and updates can be tailored to you.

---

## One-time tier — Backer (US$5 one-time)
Tier price: $5 (one-time)

Tier description:
One-time supporters help fund a single development sprint or print run. Backers will have their profile badge shown on the sponsors page and receive project email updates for one month following the contribution.

Welcome message (shown after payment / in welcome email):
Thank you for backing the project! Your one-time support funds a focused improvement. You will receive a brief update email and a download link to the latest A4 label pack.

---

# Notes
- Markdown styling is supported in tier descriptions and welcome messages (limit 750 characters per field where applicable).
- To publish these tiers on GitHub Sponsors, enable Sponsors on your account and copy/paste these fields into the Sponsors dashboard UI.
- I can prepare the exact 750-character-limited strings if you want them optimised for the Sponsors form.
